title: RelativeGradientStrongQuasar.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: The strong quasar-convexity condition permits nonconvex objectives; neither convexity nor ordinary strong convexity is required.

problem_class.label: quasar
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable, globally L-smooth, (γ, μ)-strongly quasar-convex function: f(x*) ≥ f(x) + ⟨∇f(x), x*−x⟩/γ + μ‖x−x*‖²/2 for every x and some global minimizer x*. Here L, μ > 0 and 0 < γ ≤ 1; f(x0)−f(x*) ≤ Δ.

oracle.label: inexact_gradient
oracle.details: A query x returns g(x), where g is one fixed measurable map satisfying ‖g(x)−∇f(x)‖ ≤ δ‖∇f(x)‖. Replies do not depend on the call index or oracle seed. No function-value oracle is supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RelativeGradientStrongQuasar.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, and the existential g clause in spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: biased_oracle
distinctive_assumptions.details: The fixed gradient error may be arbitrarily biased within the relative-error bound; no unbiasedness, independence, or averaging assumption is imposed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RelativeGradientStrongQuasar.lean: spec.admissible, O.answer k (0, x) seed = g x.

distinctive_assumptions.label: relative_error
distinctive_assumptions.details: The error bound holds pointwise on the entire space, relative to the true gradient norm, with publicly known 0 ≤ δ < 1.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RelativeGradientStrongQuasar.lean: spec.valid, spec.admissible, Public := Params, and publicInput.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space equipped with its Borel measurable structure.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RelativeGradientStrongQuasar.lean: Params.finiteE, Params.measurableE, Params.borelE; LongTails/Setups/SmoothAndConvex.lean: Public.normedE, Public.linearE, Public.completeE.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E, x0, L, μ, γ, δ, Δ, and ε are public. The objective, minimizer, and oracle map are hidden. The initial objective-gap bound Δ ≥ 0 is available without function-value access.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RelativeGradientStrongQuasar.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.Instance, and spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a point X ∈ E with integrable objective gap and E[f(X)−f(x*)] ≤ ε for some global minimizer x*, where ε > 0.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Accuracy is in expectation over the algorithm and oracle seed laws, under a fixed oracle-call budget. Deterministic oracle replies do not require the algorithm or its output to be deterministic.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RelativeGradientStrongQuasar.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm, execute, and Convergence.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines possibly nonconvex strong quasar-convexity with a fixed, potentially biased relative-error gradient oracle and gradient-only information. No repository implementation or proof was inspected; the absence of a qualifying verified reference does not establish novelty.

descriptionHtml:
Strong Quasar Minimization with Relative Errors

We consider minimizing a differentiable function f:E→R on a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space E. The function has an L-Lipschitz gradient, with L>0, and is strongly quasar-convex with parameters μ>0 and γ∈(0,1] relative to a global minimizer x⋆. A given point x0∈E satisfies f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ, where Δ≥0. The oracle returns a fixed measurable vector g(x) satisfying ∥g(x)−∇f(x)∥≤δ∥∇f(x)∥, with δ∈[0,1). For ε>0, the goal is an output x¯∈E with integrable objective gap and EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε, where P is the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ on E. The algorithm receives E, L, x0, μ, γ, δ, Δ, and ε.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Smoothness). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E, and ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥,x,y∈E.

Assumption 2 (Strong quasar-convexity and initial gap). There exists x⋆∈E such that f(x⋆)≤f(x),x∈E,f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ. Relative to this same minimizer, strong quasar-convexity means that, for every x∈E, f(x⋆)≥f(x)+1γ⟨∇f(x),x⋆−x⟩+μ2∥x−x⋆∥2.

Assumption 3 (Relative gradient error). The oracle returns g(x) at any query point x∈E, where g:E→E is a fixed Borel-measurable map satisfying ∥g(x)−∇f(x)∥≤δ∥∇f(x)∥,x∈E.

After the allotted oracle calls, the output must have an integrable objective gap under P and satisfy EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε.

On a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel measurable structure, f has an L-Lipschitz gradient and a minimizer x⋆ satisfying f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ and f(x⋆)≥f(x)+γ−1⟨∇f(x),x⋆−x⟩+μ2∥x−x⋆∥2 for all x. Here L,μ,ε>0, 0<γ≤1, Δ≥0, and 0≤δ<1. Each oracle call returns the same measurable g(x), with ∥g(x)−∇f(x)∥≤δ∥∇f(x)∥. Target: ∫(f(xK(ω))−f(x⋆))dP(ω)≤ε, with integrable gap and P the algorithm’s randomization law. The setup does not restrict the algorithm; (1) constructs a randomized continuized method.

import LongTails.Setups.SmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2

open MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.RelativeGradientStrongQuasar

open OracleTemplate

structure Params extends toGradientPublic : LongTails.Setups.SmoothAndConvex.Public.{0} where
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  μ : ℝ
  γ : ℝ
  δ : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

attribute [instance] Params.finiteE Params.measurableE Params.borelE

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := p.E → ℝ
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 0 < p.L ∧ 0 < p.μ ∧ 0 < p.γ ∧ p.γ ≤ 1 ∧
    0 ≤ p.δ ∧ p.δ < 1 ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p f O :=
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ p.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ g : p.E → p.E, Measurable g ∧
      (∀ k x seed, O.answer k (0, x) seed = g x) ∧
      ∀ x, ‖g x - gradient f x‖ ≤ p.δ * ‖gradient f x‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧ f p.x0 - f xstar ≤ p.Δ ∧
      ∀ x, p.γ * f x + ⟪gradient f x, xstar - x⟫ +
        p.γ * p.μ / 2 * ‖xstar - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ p.γ * f xstar)
  successful p f output P :=
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => f (output ω) - f xstar) (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, f (output ω) - f xstar ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.RelativeGradientStrongQuasar
